D3a-23 opened after re-orienting (head, stage file, diary, validate --open D3 with the known EXPECTATIONS.jsonl error, handback-C5.md's claim, the model's unruled elements via d3_ruled_by_element.py). Group: P15, the bare answer, the heaviest unruled standing element (789 lines: instantiate 646, absent 79 (9 evidenced, 70 limits), restrict 38, link 11, add-step 9, add-condition 6; no contradict). Its statement: 'A member answers a call or proposal in one line that joins, assents, reports a part done or thanks, and the line asks for nothing back'; range from 'On it.' to 'Did my part.'; tier FP-01 (form pass), no dimension, so its lines are carried through no third-order tier. A12 (P01 to P15, standing, never counted as an order) runs into it, grounded on F-023; F-014 (bounded) is its attack-call side. C01 (777) and C02 (715) are the other unruled standing elements. A slip at the opening: a cut -c after a model read was refused by the permission check; I use scripts instead. G28 is written before any line is read

G28 written in notes-D3.md before any P15 line was read: P15 is shown when a member answers a call or a proposal with a short reply that joins, assents, reports their own part done or thanks, and asks for nothing back ('On it.' to 'Did my part.'). Covers joining a call (attack calls among them), assent to a proposal (design, plan, move, deal or terms, from either room's record), a member's own part reported in answer to a call, thanks in answer to a call, proposal or offer; visitors answering the room's call count; a reason beside the assent does not bar it; the answer must be written. Not shown by the call or proposal itself (P01, P02, P04, P08), a reply that asks something back (question, request, condition), a refusal, doubt, counter-proposal or argument (A12, A16), a state report, cheer, own-part claim or thanks to another room that answers no call or proposal (P03, P11, P16 alone), or a long post doing more. Not universal; G2, G3 rule absent lines; G9 rules restrict lines; F-023 re-examined if corrections meet twice. Statements expected under G4a: A12, P01, P02, P03, P04, P08, P11, P16, P09, A16
